T: Cream puffs at the palace. Rum after.
D: Jack Sparrow is forced aboard Blackbeard's ship on a race to the Fountain of Youth.
P: Serve dessert when Jack helps himself to the cream puffs at King George's palace.
S: Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on crushed ice with a cocktail sauce.
the London tavern where Jack finds Angelica
Mini beef pies of mince and gravy in shortcrust with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
the Spanish fleet racing for the Fountain
Green and black olives marinated with orange peel, garlic, chilli and olive oil, with manchego.
M: the Spanish are racing for the fountain too

Saffron rice with chicken, chorizo, prawns and mussels, cooked in one wide pan. Brown 400g chicken thighs and 1 sliced chorizo, add an onion and capsicum, then 300g paella rice, saffron, paprika and 900ml stock.
the jungle island with the Fountain of Youth
Pork shoulder rubbed with jerk spices, slow cooked at 150C for 4 hours, pulled with rice and beans.
W: Jack eating the cream puffs at the palace
Choux pastry baked at 200C until puffed, filled with vanilla custard cream and dusted with icing sugar.
K: the waters of the Fountain of Youth
Coconut water, pineapple juice and lime, or with a splash of rum.

s.how: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach 2 minutes, then plunge into iced water. Peel and serve on crushed ice with mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce and hot sauce.

s.note: the Spanish fleet racing for the Fountain
s.how: Toss 150g green olives and 150g kalamata olives with strips of orange peel, sliced garlic, a pinch of chilli and olive oil. Leave for an hour. Serve with thin wedges of manchego for a Spanish galleon crew.

m.note: the Spanish are racing for the fountain too
m.how: Brown 400g chicken thighs and 1 sliced chorizo, add an onion and capsicum, then 300g paella rice, saffron, paprika and 900ml stock. Simmer 15 minutes without stirring, add 300g prawns and 500g mussels and cook 6 minutes more.

w.note: Jack eating the cream puffs at the palace
w.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe small mounds and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Fold whipped cream into custard, fill each puff and dust with icing sugar. Royal treats.

d.note: the waters of the Fountain of Youth
d.how: Fill glasses with ice. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice and squeeze in half a lime. Add 30ml dark rum for those drinking. Two chalices, one with a tear, is optional.
